subject: design/argus-ledger-lint
statement: Give the Argus ledger classes their Q-1 mechanical guard as **two self-registered `docgate` checks composed under the existing `docgate gate` umbrella, sharing one per-class parse package, both report-only** *(design-brainstorm:argus-ledger-lint-tech-design#D-1)*. The **history arm** (base-requiring) parses each in-scope ledger at the merge base and the working tree into a map of **`anchor → entry-block bytes`** and requires every *previously-merged* `A-n`/`E-n` anchor to survive present-and-byte-identical — a changed block is an edit, an absent one a removal, and a new higher-numbered anchor is an invisible legal append *(#D-2, #D-3)*. The **cross-document arm** (base-free) enumerates the **tracked corpus via `git ls-files`**, recognizes an in-scope `delivery:<concrete-slug>#<anchor>` citation only when `<concrete-slug>` names an existing `docs/problems/<concrete-slug>/delivery.md` (the FR-9 recognition boundary), and resolves the anchor against a version-pinned parse of the delivery-ledger's two regions — into a journal `E-n` (legal), the derived-state region (DINV-6 defect), or neither (a distinct unresolvable-anchor defect) *(#D-4, #D-5)*.
